system.description:
Allows the character to heal physical injuries through touch, including some severe trauma.
Level 1: Heals 5 Health Points
Level 2: Heals 10 Health Points
Level 3: Heals 15 Health Points
Level 4: Heals 20 Health Points
Level 5: Heals 25 Health Points
Level 6: Heals 30 Health Points
